Case N17: segment the peripheral nerve sheath tumor on this T2-weighted MRI.

Volume: 131x131x110 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text: Case N17 is complete. The peripheral nerve sheath tumor was segmented as a single 3.6 mL component: a T2-hyperintense fusiform mass in the posterior thigh (extent ~15 × 17 × 30 mm), with the outline following the lesion boundary in axial, coronal and sagittal planes.
